speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
text: asked	the Minister for National Development (a) what is the current process for a small business to get an alternative site from HDB or JTC to continue their business if their shop/office is destroyed by fire; and (b) whether the Ministry will consider expediting the process so that the affected businesses can make a quick recovery to resume their business.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: I have a supplementary question on transitional units.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: There is no fixed figure at any one time.
